title: Terminal Typing Trainer
description: A local Terminal Typing Trainer workbench with a runnable initial core and a staged improvement roadmap.

steps.goal: Add typing accuracy and words per minute to Terminal Typing Trainer, using the domain fields exercise, seconds, and lesson. Preserve existing behavior and return deterministic results for empty data.
